Practice files and expected results

Check a tool before selecting your own documents. Every file below is synthetic and contains no real personal information. These examples describe specific operations, not a guarantee that every PDF feature will be preserved.

Download a practice file

  • four-page practice report: Cover, Contents, Results and Appendix, in that order.
  • One-page cover and two-page attachments: use together for merging.
  • 1,000 × 400 practice image: a SAMPLE drawing for resizing.

Image resizing check

Select the practice image in Signature resizer. Turn off the aspect-ratio link, set 300 × 100 pixels, choose Fit and PNG, and set the minimum to 0 KB and maximum to 100 KB (decimal). The 1,000 × 400 drawing should become 250 × 100 inside the output, with 25 white pixels on each side. Crop mode instead cuts part of the source from the top and bottom. These are illustrative dimensions, not an official application requirement.

Compare with reference outputs

These files were generated from the same four-page report using the application’s processing code: extract 1, 3, remove 2, reorder 1, 2, 4, 3, and rotate page 3 by 90°. Compare visible page content and order rather than file hashes, which may change with document metadata.

Check your result independently

Open downloaded PDFs in a separate reader. Count pages, read labels and check orientation. Extract ZIPs before opening their contents. For resized images, use Check image requirements on the downloaded file and also inspect it visually.

If the sample works but your own file does not, the source may use unsupported features or exceed a limit. If the sample also fails, include your browser and error text in a problem report. Never send sensitive documents to demonstrate a bug.
